mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated rates reduce the present value of future equity cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above its 5-year median, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 5.0% indicates a deteriorating labor market, which typically precedes economic slowdowns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the number of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and retail and food services sales (RSAFS) signals robust economic growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances where both PAYEMS and RSAFS have increased in the prior month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined as FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0% and increasing for at least 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS increased by at least 0.5% in the last 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS increased by at least 0.5% in the last 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 3-month moving average indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < INDPRO(t-3mo), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) above its 12-month average indicates strong consumer confidence and near-term economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 40% of periods when HOUST > HOUST(t-12mo), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 2.0% indicates robust economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 40% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by UNRATE < 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to the risk of central bank tightening and economic overheating.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.
